head: 70b7749bea851b3110d09d66f09eccca621a2d0f
question: Does a frozen target-conditioned mask reader trained across scenes transfer to videos excluded from its training, compared with the same reader without FlyVis?
labels: YOLO26n-seg pseudo-labels matched to the existing detector box by maximum bbox IoU, require IoU>=0.5 and >=80% of selected mask inside supplied ROI. Training masks may contain teacher errors; manual QA flags excluded before fit. Evaluation uses independent manually reviewed visible cores; incomplete contours disclosed.
task: Binary visible target vs other, conditioned on existing same-frame detector ROI. This changes old scene-specific red/black labels to transferable target/background classes. It is a conditional segmentation diagnostic, not identity recovery or full tracking.

reader.kind: Same class-balanced ridge lambda1 with unpenalized intercept as prior probe; binary classes
reader.normalization: training accepted cells only; per-arm mean/SD; SD<1e-12=>1
reader.geometry: 6 shared features: normalized relative x,y,x^2,y^2,x*y,inside detector ROI
reader.training_cell: positive mask footprint>=0.9, negative<=0.1; intermediate ignored
reader.weighting: equal video, equal frame within video, equal class within frame

learning_sizes: one earliest accepted frame per training video
acceptance: Training/test videos disjoint, frozen before teacher predictions. Test clips have no prior manual mask reader fit; historical unrelated tracking use disclosed.
Same retinal sequence, ROI, coordinate features, normalization fit only on training, reader and lambda=1 for FlyVis and no-FlyVis control. No core/fulltracker changes.
Manual conservative test cores and definite non-target regions drawn on original images before reader predictions; unknown ignored. Automatic teacher labels remain pseudo-labels, not ground truth.
Independent recomputation of saved predictions/metrics and no source changes.

Mask feasibility: mean per-video known-region target IoU>=0.5, all four test videos>=0.3. Additional FlyVis benefit: positive mean difference vs matched retinal history and positive difference in at least three of four videos.
Report teacher misses/merges and all heldout cases; no test-directed hyperparameter or threshold selection.
scope: Cached flow-pretrained frozen FlyVis000; no new core training. New test means unseen by this mask reader, not unused by every historical project experiment. Same nonlinear Lamina retina/history on both arms. Conservative known-region IoU is not full silhouette IoU.
stop: Stop for failed provenance/alignment, nonfinite values, any train/test video overlap, fewer than8 accepted training videos, or <3 positive and3 negative cells per training example. Excluded examples retained in report.
budget: Single small teacher GPU pass <=20minutes; CPU reader and audit <=20minutes; artifacts expected under250MiB, all E. No new downloads or environment changes.
counterargument: The geometry or retinal history alone may explain mask quality; noisy teacher masks can cap performance. This test does not isolate data volume if compared with old scene-specific three-class task.
